QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Hayato's Message
QuestInfo.1: A beautiful smile spreads across Princess Sakuno's face as she watches the message. She's clearly very proud.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Hayato's message to #bPrincess Sakuno#k, who was incredibly proud to see how well Hayato and all of the Sengoku Warriors are doing.
